description: Every agentic action must carry a resolvable AgentID bound to a valid KYA credential (NIST IAL2 human principal).
name: agent_identity_resolved

description: A consequential action must be preceded by a passed, authenticated approval gate.
name: consequential_action_approved

description: KYA/vLEI credentials must not be within the expiry window (proposed threshold < 30 days).
name: credential_not_expiring

description: Consequential actions may proceed only while the referenced Deterministic Control Envelope (AlgoCertificate) is current and not invalidated.
name: dce_current_for_consequential

description: Each consequential message should carry a DecisionPathID linking to a reconstructable decision graph.
name: decision_path_reconstructable

description: At Tier 4 a default-deny authorisation must be confirmed before any tool call.
name: default_deny_confirmed

description: Tier 4 (Critical Autonomous) release requires two distinct authenticated approvals before proceeding.
name: dual_approval_critical

description: Every consequential action must resolve to a declared IntentID — the pre-declared objective and constraint set that authorised it.
name: execution_linked_to_intent

description: Every action must carry the verifiable LEI (vLEI / AgentOwnerLEI) of the regulated entity on whose behalf the agent acts.
name: legal_entity_vlei_present

description: No runtime guard (alignment/confidence/policy-boundary) violation may occur in the trajectory.
name: no_guard_violation

description: No action may attempt a transition that is not defined in the governed transition system for the current state.
name: no_prohibited_transition

description: External-facing release or dispatch may occur only after an authenticated approval event whose scope covers the intended action (Szpruch capability C4: Gated Release & Dispatch).
name: no_release_without_authenticated_approval

description: Capability C2 (Deterministic Numeric Computation): numeric results must be recomputed by a deterministic (non-LLM) calculator, not asserted by the model.
name: numeric_recomputed_deterministically

description: Capability C3 (Policy-Constrained Drafting): drafted outputs must comply with approved templates and policy rules.
name: outputs_policy_constrained

description: The governing PolicyRefID must reference a current, certified policy document (not superseded or revoked).
name: policy_reference_current

description: Capability C1 (Retrieval & Attribution): retrieved data must carry provenance and recency checks before it is relied upon.
name: retrieved_data_attributed

description: Every required governance-semantic telemetry span (capability invocations, tool calls, guard evaluations, approval events) must be recorded.
name: telemetry_spans_complete

description: The number of tool calls in a single workflow must stay within the per-workflow budget. Budget shown as 20; set per deployment.
name: tool_call_budget

description: Every tool/capability invocation must lie within the certified allowlist for the agent's tier.
name: tool_calls_allowlisted

description: The execution trajectory length must stay within the certified maximum (Lmax). Bound shown as 50; set per deployment.
name: trajectory_within_bound

description: Every action must fall within the active ConstraintSet binding the execution (limits, permissions, risk envelope).
name: within_constraint_scope
